key_architectural_decisions: Modular pluggable CV interfaces (FaceDetector, EmbeddingExtractor, FaceQualityAssessor, FaceAnnotator)
Default models: OpenCV YuNet (detection) and OpenCV SFace (recognition)
Multi-pass detection (full-image + sliding overlapping tiles) with NMS deduplication
Never commit real biometric data or photos to git; temporary photos auto-deleted after processing
Consent-based student enrollment with audit logging; flush-before-audit-log pattern
One-to-one bipartite matching to prevent duplicate face assignments in the same session
Human review mandatory before attendance is finalized
